name: আমার ছোটবেলা
status: Working Bengali Next.js app implemented locally; not publicly deployed or piloted
userTask: Make a small Bangla postcard of personal childhood memories that a friend can answer with their own card.
audienceHypothesis: Adults who enjoy exchanging childhood memories with friends or relatives. Recruit people from different places, generations and levels of digital confidence. This is a hypothesis, not demographic evidence.
boundedV1: Fully Bengali pages and help, with a self-hosted Noto Sans Bengali font.
An editor-reviewed set of 12 original illustrated memories, including games, objects and everyday moments from different settings.
Choose 1 to 8 memories, add an optional name, preview one postcard layout and download a PNG.
Include the invitation: তোমার ছোটবেলা কেমন ছিল?
Keep selections in page memory; provide a clear reset button.
exclusions: Accounts, public galleries, comments, leaderboards and personality or national-identity scores.
Face uploads, AI image generation, copyrighted characters and music.
Theme collections, travel maps and automatic Facebook posting.
Persistent storage and production analytics in the first pilot.
journey: Read a one-sentence example and see the available memories.
Select 1 to 8 memories; add a name only if wanted.
Review the postcard and edit any selection.
Download it and choose where to share it.
differentiator: A personal memory collage with a conversational invitation. Unseen Bangladesh records visited places. Generic AI nostalgia formats alter photos. This tool uses the user's own chosen memories; novelty and demand remain unproven.

dataAndPrivacy.content: Checked-in memory data and original local illustrations; record artwork ownership and review language before use.
dataAndPrivacy.userData: Optional name and selected memory IDs stay in browser memory. Do not send them to a server, include them in URLs or log them.
dataAndPrivacy.sharing: Only the downloaded image contains the chosen name and memories. Explain that the user controls sharing.
dataAndPrivacy.pilotRecords: With consent, record anonymous task outcomes and aggregate counts manually. Do not collect postcard contents or profile links.

acceptanceCriteria: A person can complete the task on a 360px-wide screen without horizontal scrolling or account creation.
All choices, editing, reset and download controls work by keyboard; selection state is announced and does not depend on color.
The preview and downloaded PNG show the same selected memories and readable Bangla, including after fonts finish loading.
Allow only 1 to 8 selected memories; show clear messages when the selection cannot be previewed or exported.
Treat the optional name as plain text, limit it to 40 characters and prevent long names from overflowing.
A failed export shows an actionable retry message and preserves selections.
A network inspection confirms that no name or selected memory IDs leave the browser.

manualPilot.status: Proposed decision thresholds; no pilot has run
manualPilot.usabilityTask: Ask each adult to make and download a card without instructions. Record where help is needed; repair blocking issues before the sharing pilot.
manualPilot.startDefinition: A consenting non-team tester selects at least one memory. Count each recruited tester once.
manualPilot.completionDefinition: The tester reaches a valid postcard preview with 1 to 8 memories.
manualPilot.exportDefinition: A PNG download completes; clicking the button alone does not count.
manualPilot.interpretation: Completion and exports assess the tool. Ask separately about voluntary sharing; neither exports nor this small sample proves virality.

nextJsArchitecture.publicPage: App Router server page for instructions, metadata and the public link preview.
nextJsArchitecture.interaction: One client builder owns selections, optional name, validation and reset.
nextJsArchitecture.content: One checked-in memory data file plus local artwork and a licensed self-hosted Bangla font.
nextJsArchitecture.export: Use one native Canvas renderer for the visible postcard and PNG download after fonts are ready; also expose the selected content as accessible text.
nextJsArchitecture.backend: None. No database, API routes, authentication or social-platform access.
nextJsArchitecture.checks: A small selection-validation check and a manual Bangla export check on Android Chrome and iPhone Safari.

dependenciesToCheckBeforeAdd: Inspect package.json, lockfile and existing UI/export helpers when implementation begins.
Use installed Next.js, React and TypeScript if present; check current Next.js documentation before setup.
Try native Canvas, document.fonts and Blob downloads first. Add an export dependency only if a reproducible Bangla or mobile problem requires it.
Check the Bangla font license and rendering. Do not add a UI library or icon package for this page.
risks: A one-use novelty can fade quickly; no viral forecast is justified.
The initial memory set may exclude some experiences. Let testers say none fit and revise the content.
Bangla shaping, long names and mobile downloads require real-device checks.
Exported names and memories become visible wherever the user shares the image.

sources.supports: Reported participation in a nostalgia photo format; no measured demand for this tool.
Reported sharing of personal travel maps; proposed postcard mechanism is an inference.
Existing travel-map product and adjacent features.
Server-rendered public page with focused browser interaction.
